summary: Somerset County, ME: 60-foot steel lookout tower put up in 1914; FFLA lists it as standing without its cab. No current access information found.

facts.design: 60-foot steel tower; the 1914 report places the station telephone in the house on top of it
facts.status_note: The tower still stands, but its cab is gone (FFLA).

access.note: No current access rules, owner or visiting guidance found in the sources read

sources.title: Lookout lists and what counts as standing

notes_for_editor: Built 1914 and the 60-foot height rest on the Forest Lookouts page (which quotes the 1914 Forest Commissioner's Report and a 1920 inventory) and a Maine Memory photo. Current standing is from the FFLA list only, with the cab-gone reading taken from the FFLA legend, so no recent photo or site visit confirms it. No access, ownership or rental source was found; access is recorded as unknown. Two Forest Fire Lookout Association Maine chapter Facebook posts describe the tower as standing without a cab, but those pages returned no readable text and are not cited. Maine Memory record 19124 is a candidate photo, but its licence was not checked, so no photo is added. No corrections proposed.
